info.title: earm
info.description: ARM-style JSON templates for Microsoft Entra ID, deployed through the Microsoft Graph API.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: EARM - ARM-style JSON templates for Microsoft Entra ID, deployed through the Microsoft Graph API.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table (default), json, jsonc (coloured JSON), yaml, yamlc (coloured YAML), tsv or none. [default: table]

options.name: --query
options.description: JMESPath query (https://jmespath.org) applied to the JSON document of the command. Without -o it selects -o json.

options.name: --auth
options.description: How to obtain tokens: auto (default: a cached 'earm auth login' sign-in when there is one, else the default chain), default (environment variables, workload identity, managed identity) or interactive. Default: EARM_AUTH.

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant id or domain to sign in to. Default: EARM_TENANT_ID, then whatever the credential selects.

options.name: --client-id
options.description: App registration (client id) used by the interactive sign-in 'earm auth login'. Default: EARM_CLIENT_ID, then the client of the stored sign-in, then Microsoft Graph Command Line Tools (none in the china cloud).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Debug logging to stderr: every Graph call (method, path, status, timing, request id; query secrets redacted, tokens and bodies never logged). [default: False]

options.name: --debug
options.description: Trace logging to stderr: as --verbose plus token acquisition and retry details (tokens are never logged). Also prints the full exception of an unexpected error; EARM_DEBUG=1 does the same. [default: False]

options.name: --evaluation-timeout
options.description: Seconds one evaluation (a variable, the properties of a resource, an output) may take before the run fails with EvaluationBudgetExceeded; 0 disables the time limit. Default: EARM_EVALUATION_TIMEOUT, then 60.

commands.name: deployment
commands.description: Validate, preview, deploy and delete EARM deployments; mirrors 'az deployment group'.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validates a template offline (JSON Schema, type catalog, semantic checks); with --validation-level Provider also against the tenant (read only).

options.name: --template-file
options.description: Path to the template (*.entra.json).

options.name: --parameters
options.description: Parameter values: @file.json or a path to a parameter file (ARM deploymentParameters shape), an https:// URL of one, an inline JSON object, name=value, or name=@file (the file content is the value). Several values per -p; repeatable; later values win. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --validation-level
options.description: Template (default): offline validation, no tenant access. Provider: also sign in and plan against the tenant (read only), checking consent for the write scopes create needs. ProviderNoRbac: the same with the read-only scopes of what-if. [default: Template]

options.name: --fetch-links
options.description: Also download the https linked templates and parameter files of nested deployments (https only, no credentials, no redirects, bounded size and time) and validate them. Off by default: validate does not use the network and reports LinkedTemplateNotFetched. [default: False]

options.name: --no-prompt
options.description: Do not ask for the value of a parameter that has none (an interactive run asks otherwise); the run then fails with MissingParameterValue. Accepts true or false. [default: False]

commands.name: what-if
commands.description: Shows the changes a deployment would make (Create / Modify / Delete / NoChange / Ignore) without applying them.

options.name: --template-file
options.description: Path to the template (*.entra.json).

options.name: --parameters
options.description: Parameter values: @file.json or a path to a parameter file (ARM deploymentParameters shape), an https:// URL of one, an inline JSON object, name=value, or name=@file (the file content is the value). Several values per -p; repeatable; later values win. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --name
options.description: Deployment name (a label shown in the output). Default: the template file stem.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Incremental: create/update declared resources. Complete: additionally report (never delete) the live objects of the declared types that the template does not declare. [default: Incremental]

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Maximum number of resources read/applied concurrently inside a dependency batch. [default: 4]

options.name: --allow-ca-enforce
options.description: Apply a Conditional Access policy's declared state 'enabled'. Without it the enforcement is held back with a warning: a new policy is created report-only, an existing policy keeps its live state. [default: False]

options.name: --on-soft-deleted-conflict
options.description: What to do when the key of a resource to create is held by a soft-deleted object. [default: error]

options.name: --device-code
options.description: When the signed-in user must consent to a delegated scope this run needs, prompt with the device-code flow instead of a browser (interactive terminals only). [default: False]

options.name: --no-prompt
options.description: Do not ask for the value of a parameter that has none (an interactive run asks otherwise); the run then fails with MissingParameterValue. Accepts true or false. [default: False]

options.name: --result-format
options.description: What-if detail: FullResourcePayloads (default) or ResourceIdOnly (resource ids only; an existing declared resource is reported as Deploy). [default: FullResourcePayloads]

options.name: --exclude-change-types
options.description: Space-separated change types the what-if does not show (Create, Delete, Deploy, Ignore, Modify, NoChange, Unsupported); they are still deployed. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --exit-code-on-changes
options.description: Exit with code 5 when the what-if reports any Create, Modify or Delete (create: when the successful deployment applied one). [default: False]

options.name: --no-pretty-print
options.description: Compact JSON output (-o json). [default: False]

commands.name: create
commands.description: Deploys a template: creates and updates the declared resources in dependency order through Microsoft Graph with the signed-in identity.

options.description: Path to the template (*.entra.json).

options.name: --name

options.name: --parallelism

options.name: --no-prompt
options.description: Do not ask for the value of a parameter that has none (an interactive run asks otherwise); the run then fails with MissingParameterValue. Accepts true or false. [default: False]

options.name: --what-if
options.description: Show what the deployment would do and exit without applying anything. [default: False]

options.name: --confirm-with-what-if
options.description: Show the what-if first and ask for confirmation before applying (use -y to skip the prompt). [default: False]

options.name: --proceed-if-no-change
options.description: With --confirm-with-what-if: deploy without asking when the what-if shows no change (only NoChange and Ignore rows, after --what-if-exclude-change-types). [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmations: the one asked by --confirm-with-what-if, and the one asked before objects are replaced (deleted and created again because an immutable property changed). Without -y, a non-interactive run that would replace objects fails before any write. [default: False]

options.name: --continue-on-error
options.description: Keep deploying resources that do not depend on a failed one (default: stop at the batch boundary). [default: False]

options.name: --reveal-secure-outputs
options.description: Print securestring/secureObject outputs in clear text instead of ***. [default: False]

options.name: --secure-outputs-file
options.description: Write the secure outputs (in clear text) to this file with owner-only permissions.

options.name: --what-if-result-format
options.description: What-if detail: FullResourcePayloads (default) or ResourceIdOnly (resource ids only; an existing declared resource is reported as Deploy). [default: FullResourcePayloads]

options.name: --what-if-exclude-change-types
options.description: Space-separated change types the what-if of --what-if / -c does not show (Create, Delete, Deploy, Ignore, Modify, NoChange, Unsupported); they are still deployed. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --exit-code-on-changes
options.description: Exit with code 5 when the what-if reports any Create, Modify or Delete (create: when the successful deployment applied one). [default: False]

options.name: --no-pretty-print
options.description: Compact JSON output (-o json). [default: False]

Several values per -p; repeatable; later values win. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --name

options.name: --device-code

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Sign in interactively, sign out, and show who EARM is signed in as.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Signs in interactively (browser by default) as yourself and caches the sign-in encrypted for later runs. The sign-in app is Microsoft Graph Command Line Tools unless --client-id names another; --scopes and -f consent the delegated scopes runs will request.

options.name: --device-code
options.description: Use the device-code flow (print a code to enter at https://microsoft.com/devicelogin) instead of opening a browser; for machines without a browser. [default: False]

options.name: --scopes
options.description: Extra delegated scopes to consent now, besides User.Read: Microsoft Graph names (Group.ReadWrite.All), qualified Graph scopes, or the Key Vault scope (https://vault.azure.net/user_impersonation). Space- or comma-separated. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --template-file
options.description: A template (*.entra.json) whose delegated scopes to consent now (computed offline, as 'earm permissions --verb' lists them).

options.name: --parameters
options.description: Parameter values: @file.json or a path to a parameter file (ARM deploymentParameters shape), an https:// URL of one, an inline JSON object, name=value, or name=@file (the file content is the value). Several values per -p; repeatable; later values win. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --verb
options.description: create|whatif|delete: the run of the template whose scopes count (default create). [default: create]

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Forgets the interactive sign-in: deletes the sign-in record and the encrypted token cache entry.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Shows how EARM signs in and who the access token belongs to (tenant, principal, client, scopes or roles); with -f, which delegated scopes a template run needs that the token lacks. Exits 3 when no credential works.

options.name: --template-file
options.description: A template (*.entra.json) whose delegated scopes to check against the token (lists the missing ones) (computed offline, as 'earm permissions --verb' lists them).

options.name: --parameters
options.description: Parameter values: @file.json or a path to a parameter file (ARM deploymentParameters shape), an https:// URL of one, an inline JSON object, name=value, or name=@file (the file content is the value). Several values per -p; repeatable; later values win. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --verb
options.description: create|whatif|delete: the run of the template whose scopes count (default create). [default: create]

commands.name: permissions
commands.description: Lists the Microsoft Graph permissions and Entra roles a template needs, offline (no tenant access).

options.name: --template-file
options.description: Path to the template (*.entra.json).

options.name: --parameters
options.description: Parameter values: @file.json or a path to a parameter file (ARM deploymentParameters shape), an https:// URL of one, an inline JSON object, name=value, or name=@file (the file content is the value). Several values per -p; repeatable; later values win. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --mode
options.description: app: Microsoft Graph application permissions of a service principal login. delegated: delegated scopes plus the Entra roles of a user login. [default: app]

options.name: --verb
options.description: whatif|create|delete: the delegated scopes one run of that verb requests for a signed-in user (implies --mode delegated).

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Print or install the JSON Schemas of the template format.

commands.name: print
commands.description: Writes a JSON Schema to standard output: the template envelope, the parameter file, or the schema of one resource type (with its x-earm overlay).

arguments.name: WHAT
arguments.description: template (default), parameters, or a resource type: Microsoft.Entra/applications, applications, conditionalAccess/policies, conditionalAccess.policies, ... [default: template]

commands.name: install
commands.description: Extracts the schemas and maps them to **/*.entra.json and **/*.entra.jsonc in VS Code (json.schemas), preserving the other settings.

options.name: --global
options.description: Write the mapping into the VS Code user settings instead of the workspace's .vscode/settings.json. [default: False]

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace directory whose .vscode/settings.json receives the mapping. Default: the current directory.

options.name: --settings-file
options.description: Settings file to merge into (overrides --workspace and --global), for editors that read the VS Code format.

options.name: --schema-dir
options.description: Directory to extract the schemas to. Default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\EArm\schemas\2026-10-01 (~/Library/Application Support/EArm/schemas/2026-10-01 on macOS, ~/.local/share/EArm/schemas/2026-10-01 on Linux).
